name: Bible Foundations
description: The big story of the Bible in 30 chapters, from creation to the new creation. Ideal if you have read some parts but want to see how they fit together.

days.title: Creation
days.explanation: The Bible opens with God making an ordered, good world and giving people a special place in it.

days.title: The fall
days.explanation: Humanity turns away from God, and sin, pain and death enter the story.

days.title: The flood
days.explanation: The world has become violent. God sends a flood but saves Noah and his family, a pattern of judgment and rescue.

days.title: The promise
days.explanation: God calls Abraham and promises to bless all nations through his family. The rest of the Bible follows this promise.

days.title: Abraham is tested
days.explanation: Abraham is asked to offer his son Isaac, and God provides a ram instead. Many readers see a foreshadowing of the cross.

days.title: Joseph sold
days.explanation: Joseph's brothers sell him into slavery out of jealousy, which will bring the family to Egypt.

days.title: Meant for good
days.explanation: Joseph forgives his brothers: "ye thought evil against me; but God meant it unto good."

days.title: Moses called
days.explanation: The Israelites are slaves in Egypt. God reveals himself to Moses at the burning bush.

days.title: The Passover
days.explanation: The blood of a lamb protects Israel on the night of the final plague. Jesus later celebrates this meal with his disciples.

days.title: Through the sea
days.explanation: God parts the Red Sea and brings his people out of slavery, the great rescue of the Old Testament.

days.title: The covenant
days.explanation: At Mount Sinai God gives the Ten Commandments to the people he has rescued.

days.title: Love the Lord
days.explanation: Moses calls Israel to love God with all their heart, soul and might, and to teach this to their children.

days.title: Into the land
days.explanation: Joshua takes over from Moses and is told to be strong and courageous as Israel enters the promised land.

days.title: The cycle
days.explanation: Israel keeps forgetting God, suffering, crying out, and being rescued. This pattern shapes the book of Judges.

days.title: Loyal love
days.explanation: A foreign widow named Ruth refuses to leave her mother-in-law. She will become an ancestor of King David.

days.title: David anointed
days.explanation: God chooses the youngest shepherd boy as king, because the Lord looks on the heart.

days.title: David and Goliath
days.explanation: David faces the giant, trusting that the battle belongs to the Lord.

days.title: A forever king
days.explanation: God promises David that his kingdom will last forever. The New Testament sees this fulfilled in Jesus.

days.title: Elijah on Mount Carmel
days.explanation: The prophet Elijah challenges the prophets of Baal to show the people who the true God is.

days.title: The suffering servant
days.explanation: Isaiah describes a servant who suffers for the sins of others. Christians read this as a prophecy of Jesus.

days.title: A new covenant
days.explanation: God promises a new covenant, with his law written on people's hearts.

days.title: Exile
days.explanation: Jerusalem falls to Babylon and the people are taken into exile, the low point of Israel's history.

days.title: Faithful in exile
days.explanation: Daniel keeps praying to God in a foreign land and is protected in the lions' den.

days.title: Coming home
days.explanation: Back in Jerusalem, the people gather to hear God's law read aloud, and they weep and celebrate.

days.title: A savior is born
days.explanation: After centuries of waiting, Jesus is born in Bethlehem and the angels announce good news to shepherds.

days.title: The risen Lord
days.explanation: Jesus rises and explains to two travelers how all the Scriptures pointed to him.

days.title: To the ends of the earth
days.explanation: Jesus sends his followers to be his witnesses everywhere and ascends to heaven.

days.title: The Spirit comes
days.explanation: The Holy Spirit is poured out at Pentecost and the church is born.

days.title: Peace with God
days.explanation: Paul explains how Christ's death brings peace with God, reversing what went wrong through Adam.

days.title: All things new
days.explanation: The Bible ends with a new heaven and a new earth, where God lives with his people and there is no more death.
